scope: Microsoft 365 for Windows (current version), wide window. Mac, web and older versions look slightly different.
tips: Hover to see a name
Rest the mouse on any button for a second. A small box (ScreenTip) shows its name, shortcut and what it does.
Small arrow ▾ = more choices
A button with ▾ next to it opens a list of options. Click the picture part for the default, the arrow for choices.
Corner arrow ↘ = full window
Many groups have a tiny arrow in the bottom-right corner. It opens the full settings window for that group.
Ribbon disappeared?
Double-click any tab name, or press Ctrl+F1, to show or hide the ribbon.
Buttons look different from this guide?
On a small or narrow screen, a whole group shrinks into one button. Make the window wider, or click the group button to see its contents.
Extra tabs appear sometimes
Click a table, chart or picture and new tabs like Table Design or Chart Design appear. These are 'contextual tabs'. Click elsewhere and they hide.
Can't find a button?
Use the search box at the top of the app (Alt+Q) and type what you want, e.g. 'freeze'. Or use 'Where's my button?' on this page.
Made a mistake?
Undo with Ctrl+Z. Redo with Ctrl+Y. You can undo many steps.
Keyboard path to any button
Press Alt once. Letters appear on every tab and button. Type them to click without the mouse.
Right-click is your friend
Right-click any cell, text or object to see the most common actions for it.
